notes.title: Armageddon Onslaught - Update #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37682644/cb168ef6a3afa87ef120a51707707cfd5715938a.gif[/img]

We hope you've had some nice holidays! We start the new year by showing you some new features we added for our upcoming new game Armageddon Onslaught.
As you can see, we decided to add guns to the game, and now the gameplay feeling is completely different, cooler, gory, and badass.
Moreover, you will be able to use angelic powers, but that's another story...
Stay tuned.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274810

notes.title: Armageddon Onslaught - A small update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37682644/cb6007eadfbb72941ef2cbc3bf08fc87064e97d0.gif[/img]

Armageddon Onslaught: Now, some of the enemies could block your attacks, which will make the sword fights tougher.
If you like it, don't forget to add the game to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274810
